name: Reploid Headquarter
desc: "Maverick Hunter" monster you control cannot be banished by your opponent's card effect. You can discard 1 card; Special Summon 1 "Maverick Hunter" monster from your hand or GY. If your opponent activate a card or effect: You can shuffle 1 "Maverick Hunter" monster you control to the Deck or Extra Deck, add to your hand or Special Summon 1 "Maverick Analyzer" monster from your Deck. You can only use each effect of "Reploid Headquarter" once per turn.
